content:
Andy Robertson believes that honing Liverpool's defences is crucial for leading Arne Slot's debut season to a championship challenge. While the team has arranged a clean sheet in their first two matches, their skills will be put to a stiff test as they take on robust opponents Manchester United on Sunday. Slot started off his tenure perfectly, with Ipswich and Brentford being unable to break through Liverpool's solid defence.

Handle the rigorous challenges posed by the competitors will be key in the season. Last year, Liverpool's conspicuous leak of 41 goals across 38 matches placed them in third position, having conceded seven more goals than the winning team, Manchester City, and twelve more than the runner-up team, Arsenal. However, the emerging pattern seems favourable. Robertson enthusiastically stated, “We couldn’t have asked for a better start than achieving a clean sheet in the first two games, which we were unable to do previously.”

"We optimistically look forward to maintaining this clean streak. We aim to minimize the scoring opportunities we allow Manchester United and all other teams in the games following the international break." he added. Robertson reflected upon the previous season's statistics, pointing out a notable point of concern. "Even when we were battling for the championship, we were likely giving away more opportunities than teams such as Arsenal and Manchester City. That increases the risk of having a match where we get penalized, as it happened during the course of last season." 

P.S. Seems like the Liverpool squad has some lessons learned from the last season. With an aggressive and watchful strategy in place, they are trying to address their drawbacks concerning strong defence tactics. Building an effective defence mechanism will play a major role in charting the course of their title-challenging ambitions. Andy Robertson's statements reflect their commitment to revising past mistakes and turning them into stepping stones for success. Only time will tell whether they are able to translate this determination into a winning streak.
